articles.title: Jet Fuel Hits a Record High — and Holiday Plane Tickets Cost More
articles.summary: Jet fuel just hit a record $4.90 a gallon, and airlines are passing some of the cost to travelers: Thanksgiving fares are up about 30%, yet most families are still booking.

articles.title: Oil Spill Spreads Along UAE Beaches Toward a Wildlife Haven
articles.summary: Oil leaking from a damaged tanker near the Strait of Hormuz has spread over 35 km and reached UAE beaches, drifting toward protected islands where green turtles live.

articles.title: Young Candidates Say Fixing Housing Starts With Living It
articles.summary: Young candidates from both parties, including a 21-year-old Montana lawmaker and two Connecticut renters in their twenties, are running on plans to make homes cheaper to rent and buy.
